mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—a space where stories breathe, and the wild spirit within every woman is invited to awaken. Deep inside each of us, there’s a part that’s untamed and fiercely alive—a wellspring of creativity, resilience, and a longing for true freedom. Have you ever felt that quiet urge, that pull to listen to your instincts and rediscover your own wildness? Together, we’ll explore the pages of Women Who Run With the Wolves, beautifully crafted by Clarissa Pinkola Estés. She weaves together ancient myths, fairy tales, and timeless wisdom from around the world, showing how the wild feminine spirit has been both hidden away and powerfully celebrated through generations. As we step into these stories, we’ll uncover a world where intuition, courage, and the cycles of life and death are honored as vital threads in the tapestry of every woman’s experience. Here, the wild woman archetype isn’t just a concept—it’s a force for healing, transformation, and deep self-discovery. It calls us to return to who we really are, to trust our inner wisdom, and to embrace the parts of ourselves we may have lost along the way. Through storytelling and the lens of Jungian psychology, this exploration becomes a chance to reclaim those lost pieces, to reconnect with the primal forces that shape who we are and why we’re here. Each tale we encounter acts like a mirror, reflecting the struggles and victories of women who dare to break free from what’s expected and find their own voice. We’ll move through darkness and light, letting go and beginning again, until we arrive at a sense of wholeness that feels both ancient and brand new. So, as you listen, imagine the call growing stronger—the invitation to run with the wolves, to rediscover your wild soul, and to celebrate the journey back to your truest self. Let’s explore this together.
